get.summary: Get all Grades for a Class during an Academic Term
get.description: Retrieves all gradebook grades for every student in a class during a specific academic term. Each student's response includes an array of task assignments with their scores, comments, and grade conversions. Returned fields for each task include: - group_mark: The percentage achieved on the task, converted using the grade scale set for the program. - score: The raw number of points a student achieved. - max_points: The total available points for the task. - dropbox_status: Upload status of the student submission. Only present if Dropbox Coursework Submission is enabled for the task. Values: waiting, early, on_time, late. - binary: Completion status for binary-graded tasks. Values: completed, incompleted. - due_date_extension_days: Number of extra days granted to the student for this task. Only present if an extension was given.

get.summary: Get Term Grades for a Class
get.description: Retrieves all term grades for a class during a specific academic term. The response shape varies depending on the program type of the class: IB Diploma, Career Programme, Cambridge, Advanced Placement, and other programs: Returns a grade (letter or number), optional exam_grade (if exam grades are enabled for the term), a computed average with percentage and grade, comments, and an array of custom rubrics. IB Middle Years Programme (MYP): Returns criterion-based grades as a hash mapping criterion letters (A, B, C, D) to numeric values (1-8), a sum of all criterion grades, optional id_grades and id_sum for Interdisciplinary Unit assessment, optional atl_skills for Approaches to Learning, comments, and custom rubrics. IB Primary Years Programme (PYP): Returns the most detailed structure including learner_profile with standards and criteria, subjects with phases, strands, and overall assessments, units with transdisciplinary themes and subject-specific assessments, optional atl_assessment, comments, and custom rubrics.

put.summary: Set or Update an Attendance Settings for a Class in an Academic Year
put.description:
Define the rotation slots for when and where the given class meets. This operation enables slots in the payload and disables slots not in the payload.

While it does not delete any individual attendance records,
it does directly affect how class attendance records for students are counted over the given academic year.
For example, if absent records exist at a given slot, they will no longer be tallied when disabled.

Note that the “Start period count from 0” setting should be ignored when forming the payload; the first slot in a day will always be `period: 1`.
There is a known incompatibility with “Get Class Timetable” endpoint that responds with periods zero- or one-indexed, depending on that setting,
but will be fixed in `v2p3`.

Removes a list of student IDs from a year group, as specified by the year group ID.
Students not currently in the group will be silently ignored.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for year group.

student_ids.description: An array of Student IDs to remove from the Year Group

get.description:
Retrieves all teachers assigned to a class, including their archive status and report visibility settings.
Each teacher record includes a show_on_reports flag indicating whether the teacher appears on printed reports,
and timestamps for when they first joined the class and when their record was last updated.
Soft-deleted teacher assignments are excluded.

parameters.name: class_id
parameters.description: The unique numeric identifier of the class.

put.summary: Set Teacher memberships for a Class
put.description:
Completely replaces the teacher memberships for a class with the provided list. Any existing
teachers not included in the payload are removed. Sending an empty array removes all teachers.
Each entry can optionally set show_on_reports to control whether the teacher appears on printed
reports. The response includes per-entry status (ok, not_found, or unprocessable_entity with errors).

parameters.name: class_id
parameters.description: The unique numeric identifier of the class.

post.description:
Adds one or more teachers to a class by their teacher IDs. If a teacher was previously removed
(soft-deleted), they are restored. Teachers who are already active members are silently skipped.

parameters.name: class_id
parameters.description: The unique numeric identifier of the class.

teacher_ids.description: An array of teacher IDs to add to the class.

delete.description:
Removes one or more teachers from a class by their teacher IDs. This performs a soft delete
of the teacher-class assignment. Teachers who are not currently assigned are silently skipped.

parameters.name: class_id
parameters.description: The unique numeric identifier of the class.

teacher_ids.description: An array of teacher IDs to remove from the class.

configurations (points, criteria, binary, comment) can be specified.
